emily: heads-up: US-CENTRAL GPU nodes failing to decrypt node secrets during join. started around 08:47 after vpce policy change.
diego: error log?
emily: keystore sidecar on gpu-usc-03:
```
2026-03-24T08:49:05Z ERROR keystore: AccessDeniedException: User is not authorized to perform kms:Decrypt on arn:aws:kms:us-central-1:111:key/cccc-7777
```
emily: this one is odd - the vpce policy enforces a tag condition on principals (aws:PrincipalTag/audit=allowed). keystore role doesn't have the tag when invoked via privatelink.
priya: we intentionally added that tag condition to prevent wildcard principals after the audit hardening PR. looks like privatelink calls lose principal tags in our principal-mapping.
sec-eng: confirmed. privatelink service principal is sts-assume-role -> ephemeral creds; our tag propagation CI doesn't catch that. Deny statement matched and shadowed the allow for keystore.
oncall-sre: mitigation options: 1) revert vpce policy (fast, loses audit guardrails), 2) add temp KMS grant scoped to the keystore role + patch vpce policy adding an explicit Allow for the keystore principal (narrow, preferred), 3) attach required audit tag to the role session via assume-role policy (longer). Recommend option 2 now.
diego: approving short-lived grant for onboarding window (2h).
emily: proposed grant command:
```
aws kms create-grant --key-id alias/keystore-usc --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::111:role/keystore-privatelink --operations Decrypt --name "usc-onboard-temp"
# set GrantTokens and TTL via vault workflow
```
emily: endpoint patch (minimal): add an explicit Allow statement for keystore role with kms:Decrypt and condition SourceVpc==vpc-0abc1234
priya: please add SourceVpc condition to reduce blast radius. also log the grant id to CloudTrail.
oncall-sre: I'll push canary to usc-az1. synthetic monitors: keystore.Decrypt and node kubelet ready. rollback threshold: >25% failures after 10m.
ops-bot: alert: keystore.kms.denied x 48 in 5m  https://ops/redwood/alerts/keystore-kms-usc
emily: creating grant now.
emily: grant created g-0xfeedface - testing on one canary node.
emily: canary decrypted and node Ready. :white_check_mark:
diego: patching vpce policy with explicit allow + SourceVpc condition, will set grant TTL 2h.
priya: follow-up action items: - update privatelink CI to simulate assume-role flows and check principal tag propagation - add policy snippet to audit-hardening PR showing explicit keystore allow - estimate cost for regional audit mirror and include in PR (ballpark $110/day)
oncall-sre: monitoring started 09:05. current recovery: 10/12 pending nodes recovered after grant+policy patch. continuing watch; will escalate to rollback if threshold met.
emily: thanks all. I'll produce a 1-pager postmortem and paste the minimal vpce policy snippet.
sec-eng: also ensure the grant is deleted after TTL and that CloudTrail captures the create-grant call.
ops-bot: unresolved alert waiting for manual close  https://ops/redwood/alerts/keystore-kms-usc
